description:
Make bulk update's per-match cost independent of repository size, so `jit issue bulk-update` at a fixed match count no longer grows with the number of issues.

## Background

- The 45d0a971 cost harness (scenario (a)) measures the tip slope ratio s(2000)/s(500) at 4.17 (threshold ≤ 1.5; base 3.83). The tip is 25x cheaper per match than base `369d35a42` (0.37 / 1.56 ms against 9.2 / 35.2 ms), but its per-match cost still grows with N.
- Invoker ruling: profile first; if graph rule evaluation is the cause, this is epic `16c53cc2` REQ-07, otherwise name the cause and apply one derived index per session, looked up per match. The profile names another cause (Rulings).
- Epic criterion: `b697a3f7` REQ-22 (story `0672b087`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The work bulk update does per matched issue reads neighbours and state through indexes built once per session; no per-match step scans the full issue list. The commit names the profiled cause.
- [hard] REQ-02: One test owns REQ-01 at the cheapest layer that observes it (for example, a per-match lookup count independent of repository size); no per-command duplicate.
- [hard] REQ-03: Scenario (a) of the 45d0a971 harness reports tip s(2000)/s(500) ≤ 1.5 in a smoke run, and so does a smoke variant of scenario (a) whose fixture declares a graph rule; the lead records both runs' numbers.



## Rulings

- Profiled cause (45d0a971 callgrind, N = 2000, 11.4M instructions per extra match): `BulkDerivation::derive` → `derive_prechecked_field_update` (`crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs` ~2022) → `derive_dependent_readiness` (~1735) → `derive_readiness_intents` (~1653) and `domain::queries::derive_readiness_corrections` (`crates/jit/src/domain/queries.rs` ~127). Each match rebuilds a `HashMap<IssueId, &Issue>` over all issues, clones the issue list, and re-runs `parse_issue_records` / `inspect_capability_path` over the captured set: O(N) per match, in memory. This is not graph rule evaluation, so the fix is one derived index and one parsed issue set per session, read per match.
- Steward ruling (just-in-time-d5): with graph rules declared, a transition still reads the full issue list (`derive_state_transition`), which REQ-01 forbids read literally, and this repository declares graph rules. In scope: graph rule evaluation's neighbour resolution on the transition path, through the `DependencyGraph` reverse-dependency index (e7635f2f). This partially satisfies `16c53cc2` REQ-07; scoped-bracket resolution and issue deletion stay with 16c53cc2. REQ-03 gains the graph-rule smoke variant. `IssueIndex` takes dependents from that same index rather than a private map (`@/inv/convention-convergence`).
title: Bulk update's per-match cost is independent of repository size
